subject: POC onboarding: stakeholders, compliance checkpoints, and contract path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@primemed.com>, Claire Holt <c.holt@primemed.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-10T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC onboarding: stakeholders, compliance checkpoints, and contract path

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and clear appetite to run a short POC against the scheduling use case. Quick recap and proposed path so we keep momentum: 

Key stakeholders (from our call)
- Economic buyer / sponsor: Michael Turner (you) — success = 20% reduction in scheduling conflicts
- Security/compliance lead: Claire Holt — will own the questionnaire and DPA review
- Procurement/legal contacts: procurement@primemed.com (procurement) and Sarah Li (legal) per Claire's follow-up

Contract & evidence path (recommended sequence)
1) NDA (mutual) — get this out today via DocuSign so we can share full logs and SSO details; expected turn time: 1-2 business days
2) Security questionnaire (we will pre-fill and attach) — Claire to confirm any additional evidence (SOC2, log retention, encryption) — expected review: 3-5 business days
3) MSA + SOW for the POC (SOW contains success criteria, measurement windows) — redline cycle: 3-7 business days depending on legal load
4) DPA — parallel to MSA where possible; security to consolidate comments (7-10 business days typical)

Requested owners & next steps
- Michael: confirm procurement/legal contacts I should loop (name + email) — target: today EOD
- Claire: confirm if SOC2 + architecture diagram will satisfy initial evidence and whether you want SSO details now
- Procurement: please confirm PO or purchase path for POC (if required)
- Ben (SE): will draft an initial SOW with success metrics and telemetry points (attachment: redwood-poc-sow.pdf stub)
- Neha (security): will prepare a filled questionnaire and a short security note we can attach to the NDA share (attachment: security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx stub)

If everyone is aligned I will send the mutual NDA via DocuSign today and attach the prefilled questionnaire and SOW. Goal: start provisioning the POC environment week of 6/2.

Thanks — I will follow up with DocuSign link once NDA is sent.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: redwood-poc-sow.pdf, security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx
From: Claire Holt <c.holt@primemed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Michael Turner <m.turner@primemed.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@primemed.com>
Date: 2025-05-11T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: stakeholders, compliance checkpoints, and contract path

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear sequence. A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- My security team will lead the DPA review. For legal, please loop Sarah Li (sarah.li@primemedlegal.com) for MSA redlines.
- Procurement contact is procurement@primemed.com (on this thread). They will confirm if a PO is needed for POC later today.
- SOC 2 Type II is required for any data access; we will need the architecture diagram showing isolation of PHI-susceptible fields.

I have attached the initial security questionnaire and highlighted the fields we care most about. Also, can you include a brief note on data retention and log access in the SOW?

Claire
Claire Holt
Head of Information Security | PrimeMed Health
c.holt@primemed.com

Subject: Re: POC onboarding: stakeholders, compliance checkpoints, and contract path (internal)

Karthik / Ben — internal note and recommended sequencing from security to minimize back-and-forth: 
1) Send the mutual NDA via DocuSign immediately (we will not share logs until signed)
2) Attach the prefilled questionnaire (I will review), and include a brief security summary (SOC2 scope, encryption at rest/in transit, key management) — I will draft this today and attach: ms-dpa-template.docx
3) Have Ben produce an SOW that calls out telemetry endpoints and the exact success metrics (20% conflict reduction target + measurement period) — that will make the legal review much faster because procurement cares about deliverables

Turn times we should expect: NDA 1-2 bd, questionnaire & security note 2-4 bd, MSA redlines 3-7 bd, DPA consolidation 7-10 bd. If procurement requires a PO before provisioning, expect an additional ~3 business days.

I'll circulate the security note and the DPA template by EOD so we can attach to the DocuSign.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Thanks all — quick status and actions I will take now: 
- I will send the mutual NDA via DocuSign this morning (link will be posted to the thread). Please sign + return: target 1-2 business days. (Attachment: NDA via DocuSign)
- Ben has attached an initial SOW (redwood-poc-sow.pdf stub) that maps success metrics and telemetry points; Ben, please confirm you shared the latest version to the Drive link.
- Neha will attach the security note / DPA template by EOD (ms-dpa-template.docx).
- Claire: once NDA is returned I'll share AWS architecture diagram and a short note on log retention and encryption.

Proposed review & execution cadence
- NDA via DocuSign (T+0 days)
- Security questionnaire + note attached (T+0 to T+1)
- MSA redline window (legal + Sarah Li): target 3-7 business days from initial MSA share
- DPA consolidation: security-led, target 7-10 business days from initial DPA share

Goal: Provision POC environment the week of 6/2 assuming NDA + questionnaire complete and procurement doesn't require an early PO. I will update the HubSpot deal and post the DocuSign envelope here once sent: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12094/HB-2025-1197

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
